titulo: Research on Photovoltaic Construction Management Based on UAV AI Recognition Technology
resumo: With the rapid development of the photovoltaic industry, photovoltaic construction management is facing more and more challenges. Traditional construction management methods have been unable to meet the needs of modern photovoltaic construction management. In order to solve this problem, this article proposes a photovoltaic construction management method based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) AI recognition technology by studying intelligent construction and utilizing advanced information technologies such as the Internet of Things, big data, and BIM. By elaborating on intelligent data organization, AI recognition algorithms, and UAV AI recognition technology architecture, the basic principles and application methods of UAV AI recognition technology are introduced in detail. Through practical applications in multiple projects, the feasibility and effectiveness of the photovoltaic construction management method based on UAV AI recognition technology are verified. The results show that the method can greatly improve the efficiency and quality of photovoltaic construction management, and realize the rapid, efficient and accurate management of photovoltaic construction projects. Meanwhile, this method can also provide strong support for the intelligent management of subsequent operation and maintenance of photovoltaic power stations, promoting the sustainable development of the photovoltaic industry. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Singapore Pte Ltd. 2025.
palavras_chave: AI recognition technology; Construction management; Photovoltaic power generation; Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)

titulo: Machine learning model to predict the cooling load of mosque buildings during the design stage
resumo: The building sector accounts for almost 40% of the total global energy consumption. Mosques are among these buildings which found to consume huge amount of energy. There is an increased demand to establish new sustainable mosques. Although the design stage proves the superiority to reduce energy consumption up to 70%, majority of previous studies were found at operation and maintenance stages. This is due to the complexity of this stage, lack of information and support tools to assist designers. The current design tools and prediction models to estimate cooling load are complex, time-consuming and fail to meet the requirement of designers especially at the design stage. This paper aims to develop a machine learning prediction model to assist mosque designers in providing a range of lowest cooling load design alternatives. In developing the model, artificial neural network was applied including back-propagation strategy and Levenberg–Marquardt algorithm. The least mean square error was at 6.27 × (Formula presented.) and the accuracy of the model reached at 99.88%. Further, nine experts were participated to estimate the effectiveness and ease of use of the prediction model. The model proved to be rapid, accurate and can be used by designers with no many simulation scenarios or complex calculations. © 2024 Informa UK Limited, trading as Taylor & Francis Group.
palavras_chave: artificial neural network (ANN); cooling load estimation; energy efficiency design; Machine learning (ML); sustainable mosques

titulo: Innovative strategy and practice of using underwater robot for marine cable inspection and operation and maintenance
resumo: This research explores underwater robot applications in marine cable inspection and maintenance with solutions to accuracy, reliability, and efficiency challenges. Current methods using human divers and remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) are expensive, time-consuming, and involve safety hazards. The suggested AI-based robotic system incorporates sensor technology, predictive maintenance, and statistical validation to maximize marine cable inspections. A quantitative research method was employed, surveying data from 400 Marine Engineers and Underwater Robotics Specialists. Statistical analysis, such as reliability analysis, regression model, and hypothesis testing, determined the influence of technology adoption, environmental aspects, and predictive maintenance on inspection accuracy and cost savings. Model fit was confirmed through CFI =0.94, RMSEA =0.047, and SRMR=0.052. Results show that Maintenance Strategy & Cost Reduction (β=0.55,p<0.01) is most influential. The research assures that AI-enhanced underwater robots provide a cost-efficient, guaranteed substitute to conventional approaches, promoting efficiency, safety, and long-term sustainability in marine cable operations. © 2025
palavras_chave: Cost reduction; Fault detection; Inspection accuracy; Marine cable inspection; Operational efficiency; Predictive maintenance; Reliability analysis; Underwater robotics

titulo: Economic Feasibility of Diesel-To-Solar Transition in Remote Islands with Carbon Credit Consideration
fonte_periodico: Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Technology Informatics Management Engineering and Environment Time E 2025
resumo: The transition from diesel to solar power in remote islands is crucial for achieving a sustainable energy system in archipelagic countries such as Indonesia. This study conducts a cost-benefit analysis (CBA) to evaluate the replacement of diesel generation with solar photovoltaic (PV) systems in East Nusa Tenggara (NTT). Three geographical configurations are examined: isolated micro-grids, islanded mini-grids, and semi-interconnected grids. Two scenarios are analyzed: (1) fuel cost savings as the primary benefit, and (2) combined benefits from fuel savings and potential carbon credit gains. The cash flow components include savings from reduced diesel fuel consumption and generator O&M costs, as well as investments and operations and maintenance costs for PV, battery, and diesel systems. The results reveal scale-dependent economic feasibility and highlight the importance of customized policy support for each grid type. By comparing costs and benefits across different geographical contexts, this study provides an evidence-based framework to guide investment decisions and policy formulation for renewable energy deployment in remote regions.  © 2025 IEEE.
palavras_chave: cost-benefit analysis; diesel-To-solar conversion; micro-grids; net zero; photovoltaic (PV) systems

titulo: Technological Status and Prospects of High-speed Electric Drive Systems for New Energy Vehicles
resumo: Electric drive systems are the core assembly components of new energy vehicles, and their comprehensive performance optimization is of great significance. To enhance the power and economic efficiency of new energy vehicles, the electric drive systems have gradually developed multiple technological pathways to improve power density. This paper focuses on high-speed electric drive systems for pure electric passenger vehicles, elaborating on the domestic and international development status of rotor structure design, loss suppression, cooling technology, and wide-bandgap power devices in automotive high-speed electric drive systems. It identifies key issues in the electric drive systems, including rotor strength, transmission system design, high-frequency control, cooling and heat dissipation, vibration and noise, shaft current, and insulation design. The development trend in new material technology of the electric drive systems is summarized, such as continuous breakthrough, deepening integration, continuous optimization of control performance, continuous improvement of operation efficiency, and accelerated construction of intelligent operation and maintenance systems. On this basis, the paper proposes development suggestions about paying attention to the balanced optimization of the comprehensive performance of the electric drive systems, strengthening the integration design of the electric drive systems and the chassis, promoting the low-carbon green development of the electric drive systems, and optimizing the cost management of the high-speed electric drive systems. © 2025 Science and Technology Review Publishing House. All rights reserved.
palavras_chave: cost control; fusion optimization design; green sustainable; high-speed electric drive; thermal management; vibration noise

titulo: Sustainable Water Systems
resumo: A practice-oriented analysis of water treatment systems using low-cost, low-maintenance technologies and sustainable water resources In Sustainable Water Systems, expert water resources researcher Miklas Scholz delivers a practice-oriented resource that comprehensively covers the design, operation, and maintenance of traditional and novel wetland systems used in water resource management. The book offers a performance analysis of existing infrastructure in constructed wetlands, soil infiltration systems, ditches, dry ponds, and silt traps in both developed and developing countries. Sustainable Water Systems addresses economic and environmental challenges, including flood retention and its incorporation into sustainable water supply systems. Readers will also find: A thorough introduction to low-cost alternatives to resource-intensive water processing plants. Comprehensive explorations of effective water technologies that work well in less developed and rural regions without access to reliable water treatment. Modelling of wetland systems and how to design them for optimal performance. Practical discussions of industrial wastewater treatment and modelling. Complete treatments of sustainable flood retention basins, including integrated constructed wetlands. Perfect for researchers, engineers, and other professionals working in the field of water resource management,Sustainable Water Systems will also benefit anyone interested in water supply engineering and wastewater treatment. © 2026 John Wiley & Sons Ltd. All rights reserved.

titulo: Road transport in the age of climate change: Advancing sustainable solutions in the United States
fonte_periodico: Research Handbook on Climate Change and Infrastructure Law
resumo: The transportation sector contributes a significant portion of annual greenhouse gas emissions globally and has also proven vulnerable to the impacts of climate change and extreme weather. Efforts are underway to reduce emissions from on-road transportation through policies designed to increase vehicle electrification, lower the carbon content of fuels, and reduce vehicle miles traveled, as well as to improve the resilience of transportation systems to climate change through decisions about infrastructure siting, design, operations, and maintenance. In the United States, these efforts are primarily carried out at state and regional levels through planning and investment decisions, but within a federal legal framework that establishes funding sources and performance management and planning requirements. This chapter discusses ways that climate change factors into the federal legal framework affecting decisions about on-road transportation investments, as well as additional federal, state, and local laws and poicies that affect efforts to reduce emissions from and enhance the climate resilience of the on-road transportation sector in the United States. © The Editor and Contributors Severally 2025. All rights reserved.
palavras_chave: Climate resilience; Electric vehicles; Low-carbon fuels; On-road transportation; Vehicle charging infrastructure

titulo: Current Status and Future Prospects of Digital Twin Technology Applications in Intelligent Transportation Infrastructure Management
resumo: Digital twin technology has emerged as a promising solution for the digital transformation of transportation infrastructure. This paper presents a comprehensive review of digital twin technology in the transportation industry, analyzing its relationship with key enabling technologies. By examining the development of digital twins across various transportation domains, we summarize the connotation, characteristics, and development trends of digital twins in transportation infrastructure. We propose a conceptual model and a digital system architecture for transportation infrastructure, along with a set of engineering application technical guidelines. Our findings reveal that current digital twin technology still faces challenges in driving the digital transformation of the transportation industry. From a theoretical perspective, the granularity of digital twin models is insufficient, lacking systematic support. In terms of application, the reconstruction of full-cycle digital processes primarily focuses on low-level applications. Future research should focus on theory innovation, data fusion, model integration, and professional applications to promote the development of digital twin technology in transportation infrastructure. Additionally, emphasis should be placed on collaborative design across disciplines and data standardization to build intelligent full-lifecycle management platforms, improve operation and maintenance efficiency, and provide new ideas and methods for sustainable development. © 2025 The Author(s). titulo: Water Reuse: Contribution of a Decision Support Model
autores: Costa, EH; Stefanutti, R; de Oliveira, UC; Matos, JS
resumo: Sustainability seeks to strike a balance between preserving the environment and meeting human needs without compromising future generations. In this context, and considering the effects of climate change on water availability, water reuse is emerging as an alternative to conventional water sources for various purposes, contributing to sustainability. Water reuse projects are, in general, not simple to implement due to different technical, environmental, social and economic aspects. In this paper, a support decision model for water reuse projects is presented, identifying relevant indicators and parameters. Based on a literature review, four indicators or dimensions (technical, social, environmental and economic) and twelve parameters (e.g., WWTP safety, transport complexity, existence of legislation, risk to health and environment, energy consumption, degree of acceptance and required investment and operation and maintenance costs) are proposed. The Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) method is used as a component of the model to determine the weights of the indicators and parameters in order to allow the calculation of a reuse feasibility index (RFI). The developed model was applied to the city of Aquiraz, Ceará, Brazil, and the RFI found was 82%, which means that the water reuse project had very high viability. The results underwent a sensitivity analysis, which confirms the consistency of the conclusions. © 2025 by the authors.

titulo: Real Situation of Digital Transformation in Japan: An Investigation and Proposals for Problem-Solving
resumo: In recent years, with the progress of the times, the aging problem has become a significant issue of attention in various countries. As aging progresses, various factors may make the sustainability and operation of social systems difficult. Such issues are known as the “2025 Cliff,” and it is anticipated that economic losses amounting to billions of dollars will occur by 2025. In this study, the authors conducted research and analysis on Japan’s aging problem and system obsolescence. The study aims to clarify the “2025 Cliff” issue, explore its causes and solutions, and examine how the promotion of Digital Transformation (DX) falls short to function as one of the solutions. It also considers the risk of recurrence in the next 30 to 50 years. Furthermore, based on the three current steps of DX promotion, the study explores methods for integrating AI technology into DX promotion and also we researches AIDX, which further evolves the foundation of the current digitalization efforts. This approach aims to solve difficulties in labor shortages, system upgrades, the subsequent operation and maintenance, ultimately achieving long-term economic and social benefits. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Switzerland AG 2025.
palavras_chave: AI; Digital transformation; Information design; Information media; Legacy system; Operational efficiency improvement; Population aging issue

titulo: Anomaly Detection in Solar PV Plants Using Drone Technology and AI for Proactive Maintenance
fonte_periodico: International Conference on Robotics and Automation Sciences Icras
resumo: Solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants are growing rapidly, so advanced monitoring techniques are needed for their efficient operation and maintenance. Manual inspections are labour and time-intensive, making them unviable for larger installations or hard-to-reach remote locations. This work utilizes drone technology in conjunction with thermal imaging and machine learning algorithms for the early detection of failing PV modules. Such thermal discrepancies can come in the way of hotspots, potential induced degradation (PID), and open circuits and can be rapidly identified by drones equipped with infrared (IR) cameras that indicate potential defects in PV modules. Additionally, CNN and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) machine learning techniques further improve the accuracy of line defects classification. Extensive research supports the use of drone-based thermographic inspections, demonstrating that they enhance detection and reduce costs compared to manual monitoring. The proposed approach enables real-time fault detection, mitigates energy losses, and prolongs the lifespan of PV systems. This work contributes to the ongoing advancements in effective, automated PV plant surveillance for sustainable and economical solar power generation.  © 2025 IEEE.
palavras_chave: Drone-Based Inspection; Hotspot Detection; Machine Learning; Predictive Maintenance

titulo: The Road to Resilience: Integrating Maintenance Strategies into Asset Management for Water and Wastewater Utilities
fonte_periodico: Proceedings Weftec 2025 98th Water Environment Federation Technical Exhibition and Conference
resumo: Water and wastewater utilities face growing challenges in maintaining aging infrastructure while meeting service targets and controlling costs. To address this, the Region of Peel developed a structured, standards-based approach to maintenance management, emphasizing governance, business processes, data, and technology integration. Through a tailored maturity assessment aligned with ISO 55000 and the GFMAM framework, the Region identified key gaps and created a roadmap for improvement. Findings highlight measurable improvements in operational efficiency, including reduced unplanned work, increased asset reliability, and enhanced planning and scheduling capabilities. By adopting best practices such as reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) and leveraging analytics, Peel demonstrated how maintenance can evolve into a strategic enabler of operational excellence. This work offers actionable insights for utilities seeking to strengthen their maintenance programs, align with industry standards, and achieve sustainable service delivery. Copyright ©2025 Water Environment Federation.
palavras_chave: GFMAM; ISO 55000; maintenance maturity assessment; Maintenance practices; strategic maintenance framework

titulo: Evaluation of the Applicability of Heuristic Optimization and Reinforcement Learning for Pavement Maintenance Planning
fonte_periodico: Lecture Notes in Computer Science Including Subseries Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence and Lecture Notes in Bioinformatics
resumo: Efficient road maintenance is crucial for the socioeconomic development of a country. However, traditional pavement analysis systems have limitations in their adaptability to the current reality, which hinders the effective planning of pavement rehabilitation operations. In response to this need, this article presents two techniques to improve decision making in the optimization of road infrastructure solutions: heuristic optimization and reinforcement learning. Both techniques present weaknesses and strengths when applied to road network maintenance management. Heuristic optimization offers robust solutions, but its effectiveness is compromised in uncertainty scenarios. In contrast, reinforcement learning stands out for its ability to adapt to changing and uncertain environments, offering more dynamic and efficient planning, but has limitations in including constraints. This study underscores the importance of adopting innovative and adaptive approaches to road maintenance planning to ensure the long-term sustainability and efficiency of road infrastructures. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Switzerland AG 2025.
palavras_chave: Heuristic Optimization; Pavement Maintenance Planning; Reinforcement Learning

titulo: Research Status and Key Scientific Issues of Intelligent Construction and Smart Operation and Maintenance of Modern Canals
resumo: Modern canals are critical infrastructure for national water security, basin resource optimization, and ecological protection. In the multifaceted context of the “Dual Carbon” Goals, rural revitalization strategy, regional coordinated development strategy, and digital transformation, traditional canal construction and operation modes are no longer sufficient to meet the diverse demands of the new era. It is essential to build a modern integrated canal system centered on intelligent construction and digital operation. This paper reviews the functional requirements and technological progress of modern canals, systematically examines the evolution of canal construction and operation management, and elaborates on the development concepts and scientific principles of intelligent construction and digital operation. It proposes that modern canal engineering must transition from traditional experience-based methods to digital, intelligent, and ecological approaches. Through an in-depth discussion of the key issues, development recommendations, and priority tasks related to intelligent construction and digital operation technology, the paper clarifies the direction for progress. Core breakthroughs include the adoption of multi-source digital twin technology, the design and integrated optimization of intelligent inspection equipment, the predictive maintenance theory for modern canal engineering, and the theory of collaborative development of intelligent construction and digital operation. These advances aim to promote high-quality development in the canal sector, forming a modern canal technology and management framework that meets national strategic and sustainable development needs. © 2025 Science and Technology Review Publishing House. titulo: Intelligent Planning and Optimization of Criteria for the Efficient Execution of Green Hydrogen Projects
autores: Rocha, CMM; Guerrero, JG; Pérez, DAF; Rivera-Alvarado, J
resumo: This study proposes a structured methodology based on the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) to identify, evaluate, and rank the most relevant criteria influencing the planning and execution of green hydrogen projects in Colombia. Drawing from a comprehensive literature review and the participation of 129 experts from academia, industry, government, and research institutions, the study categorizes five main criteria—economic, environmental, technical, social, and risk alongside 40 specific sub-criteria. These were assessed using fuzzy pairwise comparison matrices and validated through statistical and consistency analysis. Results indicate that the economic dimension is the most influential (42.84%), followed by environmental (28.06%) and social (10.91%) aspects. At the sub-criteria level, operation and maintenance costs, return on investment, and the use of renewable energy to power electrolyzers emerged as key priorities. The novelty of this work lies in the contextualized application of FAHP in an emerging country setting, combining expert judgment with fuzzy logic to support decision-making under uncertainty. The proposed model offers a replicable and adaptable framework for public policy development and investment planning and may be extended to similar Latin American (LATAM) contexts facing infrastructural and regulatory challenges. titulo: Durability for Sustainability a Balance Between Optimization and Robustness
resumo: Of all the inputs of a project from the inception to the decommissioning, the Durability components impact the Sustainability related to the deterioration of our environment, the local and global economy and the societal impacts by increasing the overall lifespan of the structure. This can simplistically be expressed as, the longer the structure lasts the more time the impacts of the initial CO2 emissions from the cement production can be averaged over time and extend the time for future rehabilitations or decommissioning impacts. From a proof like exercise noting a quote from Benjamin Franklin “Time is Money” we could state “Time is Durability” and as time or Durability increases so then does the Sustainability increase or “Durability is Sustainability”. Throughout the phases of project development of feasibility studies, initial concept, final design, construction, operation and maintenance and finally decommissioning (end-of-life) a fine balance of decisions, related to Durability, from the planners, engineers, and contractors, as well as maintainers will have significate impacts to the life of the structure. This paper will discuss the philosophical balancing of decisions through each phase of project development to provide a path or thought process to a sustainable project that is both durable and robust. © fédération internationale du béton (fib).

titulo: Technological innovations in sewage treatment plants for sustainable landscape design
resumo: The applicable conditions and scope of the underground sewage treatment plant include a small amount of sewage, less available land on the ground, special requirements for the above-ground landscape, low groundwater level, easy-to-excavate geology, and the buried depth of the sewage return pipe is not very large. It is not under the main road, has a certain distance from residential buildings, is not a depression, does not accumulate rainwater, and the sewage discharge requirements are not very strict. The underground sewage treatment plants are suitable for construction in areas where thermal insulation needs to be considered, less requisitionable land area, and higher environmental requirements. The results of the underground landscape design study showed that the design of principles, features, styles, water ecologies, a combination between community friendly and ecologically friendly, operations and maintenance cost of the underground landscape should be emphasized. The construction of the ecological complex will lead the sewage treatment plant exchange from minus assets to ecological positive assets, which will meet the needs of future urban social economic development and environmental protection. The results of the development direction exploration study showed that innovation in the design concept, breakthroughs of key sewage treatment technology, and variation of investment and operation mode can reduce the land occupation investment and operation cost, and the underground sewage plant with large-scale and semi-underground mode owes broader prospects for development. © The Author(s), under exclusive licence to Springer Nature B.V. 2025.

titulo: Analysis of the optimisation effect of bioelectric technology development on the structure of sports industry
fonte_periodico: Australian Journal of Electrical and Electronics Engineering
resumo: Microgrids have low energy input voltage and perform better in low-voltage scenarios, but wind and photovoltaic power generation are unstable, affecting continuous current output and power flow. While combining microgrids with bioelectric technologies is theoretically feasible, power generation stability must be addressed. Thus, this paper proposes a joint regression analysis method to integrate the two, collect voltage and current data to balance power flow in sports equipment, and enhance enterprise industrial application. First, microgrid data was standardized via a signal identification device, and a joint database with bioelectricity was built. Then, signals like power flow and voltage were analyzed to locate data anomalies. Finally, effects were judged based on microgrid power flow output, bioelectric identification accuracy, etc. Results show: the impact of power flow changes on energy consumption is 2.396, the proportion of new energy in energy consumption is 79.88%, their integration is good, and the power fusion coefficient is 0.42 (significantly higher than 0.22 for operation and maintenance). Conclusions indicate microgrids meet low-voltage bioelectric needs, bioelectricity promotes their energy structure adjustment, and expands their application in the sports industry under the joint regression algorithm. © 2025 Engineers Australia.

titulo: Project-accompanying strategies for sustainable material selection
resumo: Project-accompanying strategies for sustainable material selection. The construction sector is Germany's most resource-intensive economic sector, despite significant progress in building operation efficiency. However, efficiency gains are often offset by rebound effects in building usage. Construction methods and materials are becoming increasingly important in energy-efficient buildings during operation. Sustainability strategies such as sufficiency and consistency often remain overlooked. The DGNB certification system supports the equitable implementation of sustainability strategies but requires a clear understanding of tasks and defined responsibilities. Central criteria include resource efficiency, circularity, and freedom from pollutants. Measures such as the use of bio-based or recycled construction materials and the ability to deconstruct buildings reduce environmental impacts and lifecycle costs. Digital tools and building resource passports enhance transparency and reusability. The DGNB system recognizes that sufficiency and consistency are key principles of sustainable construction. A team-oriented approach supported by digital tools facilitates the integration of sustainability aspects and maximizes their potential. © 2025, Ernst und Sohn. All rights reserved.

titulo: Optimization of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure using Adaptive Large Neighbourhood Search
fonte_periodico: Proceedings of 5th International Conference on Ubiquitous Computing and Intelligent Information Systems Icuis 2025
resumo: The growth of electric vehicles (EVs) has created an urgent demand for reliable charging infrastructure in cities. However, selecting where to deploy stations is a challenging decision, as it must reconcile financial limitations, user preferences, and long-term sustainability objectives. This work develops a planning framework that integrates a behavioural demand model with an Adaptive Large Neighbourhood Search (ALNS) heuristic to design profitable and resilient charging networks. The demand component is based on a nested logit structure, capturing how drivers weigh distance, charging cost, and local amenities when choosing stations. The optimization module evaluates 10-year revenues and costs, including construction, operations, and maintenance, to identify the most advantageous set of sites. Several scenarios are studied: a five-station, high-growth case emphasizing convenience; a four-station, sustainability case balancing economics with green goals; and smaller rollout cases for constrained budgets. The algorithm provides not only a single best solution but also alternative portfolios that remain close to optimal, improving robustness if conditions change. Results show that the approach can guide planners toward infrastructure strategies that are financially viable, responsive to demand, and adaptable to uncertain urban futures.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Modern Floating Wind Energy Technologies
resumo: Floating offshore wind is a relatively nascent technology which overcomes the current techno-economic depth restrictions imposed by bottom-fixed substructures. Due to this great potential, floating offshore wind will soon enter the commercial deployment phase. With a full pipeline of projects towards Final Investment Decision (FID) until 2030 and the set out goals for 2050 the reduction of its Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) is a key target. Increasing its energy density, always granting technology feasibility and reliability while seeking a minimal environmental impact is an important aspect which can be achieved by new component designs, upscaled wind farms, thorough and multi-disciplinary development and optimised maintenance strategies resulting in cost-efficient Floating Energy Systems Integration (FESI). This chapter introduces and assesses the latest floating wind technologies, the optimised integration of multiple turbines in FOWFs, network integration recommendations and control strategies. Additionally, the main concepts related to the development, Transport and Installation (T&I), Operation and Maintenance (O&M) and decommissioning stages necessary to achieve a favourable cost balance and a sustainable technology deployment are described. Finally, the combination of floating wind power with other energy sources such as wave energy and energy storage systems (e.g., offshore hydrogen) are introduced as modern alternatives to achieve integrated floating offshore wind energy systems. These innovations lead towards cost-efficient Offshore Multi-Energy Systems (OMES) that take advantage of shared exploitation areas and infrastructure. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Switzerland AG 2025.

titulo: Driving Towards Sustainability: V2G Technology and Future Prospects
fonte_periodico: Proceedings of the International Conference on Green Energy and Applications Icgea
resumo: As the number of renewable energy sources connected to the grid and electricity demand grows, the electricity system faces unprecedented stability challenges as it responds to carbon neutrality policies. Vehicle-to-grid (V2G), as an emerging technology, can alleviate the stability problems caused by the peak-valley effect of the grid. This study dynamically analyzes the economic and environmental benefits of V2G applications in the context of increasing electric vehicle (EV) ownership, considering costs associated with battery charging, degradation, investment, and operation and maintenance. The results show that by 2060, the daily peak shaving potential of V2G will reach 76.87 TWh, potentially avoiding approximately 69.32 million tons (Mt) of carbon emissions. With advances in battery technology, the levelized cost of storage (LCOS) for V2G is projected to decrease to 0.39 CNY.kWh-1 by 2060, increasing the net present value (NPV) per vehicle to 163.13 thousand CNY, with carbon emission reductions reaching 0.37 Mt. These results indicate that V2G has great potential for application in future energy systems and can bring significant economic and environmental benefits.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Space cooling through dual-axis paraboloid solar concentrator system
fonte_periodico: Energy Sources Part A Recovery Utilization and Environmental Effects
resumo: The design parameters, structure and component materials significantly impact a solar dish concentrator system’s performance, operation, and maintenance. Recently, solar cooling has emerged as a cutting-edge technology, particularly advantageous for regions with abundant sunlight. This study aims to assess the efficacy of a solar cooling system by employing a combination of a parabolic trough collector and a storage tank to develop a numerical model to evaluate the system’s dynamic performance. Utilizing a 12 m2 aperture parabolic dish concentrator (PDC) module, it is successfully demonstrated that approximately 24 m2 of building space can be effectively cooled for around 12 h/day throughout the entire summer season. The optimal specific mass flow rate is 0.028 kg/cm2, with optimum storage tank volume at 0.34 m3. A single PDC module with a 300-l tank and 95.3 kWh of solar energy per day can provide 3 kW of cooling with a solar performance coefficient of 0.52 to 0.67. UNDP has provided INR 8 lakhs (15% of benchmark cost) and VAM of INR 6 lakhs (10%) of INR 30 lakhs in financial support. This study significantly promotes solar-assisted space cooling as a sustainable and eco-friendly technology. © 2025 Taylor & Francis Group, LLC.

titulo: Monitoring and Diagnosis of Railway Axles
resumo: Rail transport is one of the most important modes of land transport for both passengers and freight. Its reliability, safety and sustainability make rail the main alternative to road transport. However, the operation and maintenance of railway equipment and infrastructures generate significant operating costs that make it unattractive. In this line and in order to obtain sustainable and affordable transport infrastructures, the shift towards predictive maintenance, such as the use of new condition monitoring systems, will be of special interest given the high maintenance cost of railway equipment. Monitoring systems will make it possible to reduce the number of maintenance interventions to be carried out and thus reduce the economic cost. In this work the preliminary design of a condition monitoring system is proposed. The system uses Artificial Intelligence based on neural networks net trained, capable of identifying changes in railway axles structure from vibration signals providing of a bogie. As an example of application the system will be trained to identify a axle cracks. Data used for this purpose is obtained from a real bogie in a scaled 1/1 testbench. the results show the advantages and drawbacks of this type of systems and the new steps. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Switzerland AG 2025.

titulo: Water, Conflict and Cooperation: Stakeholder Perspectives on the Surface Water Treatment Plant Operation in Rohingya Refugee Camps
resumo: Following the 2017 influx of Forcibly Displaced Myanmar Nationals (FDMNs) into Bangladesh, over 940,000 individuals have settled in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, severely straining the region’s natural resources, particularly water. In response to groundwater scarcity and sanitation challenges in Camp 22, a Surface Water Treatment (SWAT) plant was established by OXFAM with UNICEF's support and later handed over to DSK for operation and maintenance. This qualitative study explores the process, risks, and operational experiences of DSK in managing the SWAT system, which supplies clean water to over 23,000 refugees and host community members. Data were collected through focus group discussions, key informant interviews and field observations, and analyzed using thematic analysis. Findings highlight that early community engagement, coordinated planning with local stakeholders, and employment opportunities for host communities helped mitigate conflict over shared water resources. However, ongoing challenges include seasonal water scarcity, environmental degradation, threats from wildlife, and social tensions stemming from prolonged refugee presence. Despite these challenges, the SWAT system has proven vital in ensuring safe water access, improving public health, and fostering social cohesion. The study emphasizes the need for sustainable water resource management, inclusive community participation and contingency planning to address emerging risks and secure long-term resilience in humanitarian settings. © 2025, Central Board of Irrigation and Power. titulo: An Innovative Integrated Model Leveraging RCM, TPM, and IIoT to Enhance Mechanical Availability in SMEs of Heavy Equipment Rental
resumo: This research introduces an integrated maintenance management model designed to enhance mechanical availability in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) within the heavy equipment rental sector-a context where limited resources and reactive practices often prevail. Current literature provides fragmented approaches, focusing either on predictive techniques or on isolated methodologies, leaving a gap for comprehensive, adaptable solutions in SMEs. To address this, the proposed model combines ReliabilityCentered Maintenance (RCM), the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), and two critical pillars of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM): Focused Improvements and Autonomous Maintenance. The model was validated through discrete-event simulation in Arena, using real operational data collected via time studies and field measurements. Results indicate that mechanical availability improved from 79.33% to 89.21% on average. These outcomes demonstrate the model's technical and economic feasibility, highlighting its potential as a scalable and costeffective solution for SMEs seeking to transition from reactive maintenance to proactive strategies.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: The Impact of Switch Faults on Train Delays: A Case Study of the Swedish Railway Network
resumo: Switches and crossings are prone to failure thus making them drivers of unreliability in the operation of many railway systems. Unreliability is directly linked to punctuality which continues to limit, among other factors, the uptake of railways as a sustainable mode of transport. To fix this issue, there is a need for a better understanding of the contribution of railway sub-systems to train delays. Therefore, this paper seeks to quantify the impact of switch faults (switch failures and switch inspection warnings) on the delay of a train, using historical train operation and maintenance data. We have investigated the increased chance of a train being delayed in the event of a switch fault and the average size of delay that can be attributed to a switch fault. We find that 1) in the event of a switch failure trains have a 1% increased chance of experiencing a dwell delay, a 0.7% increased chance of experiencing an arrival delay, and a 0.1% increased chance of experiencing a departure delay for non-stopping trains; 2) the impact of switch inspection warnings on train delays is negligible; and 3) on average, a train is delayed by six extra minutes in the event of a switch failure. This study serves as a step towards quantifying primary delays and their origin in the railway system. Understanding the sources serves the purpose of informing decision-makers on the areas for prioritization during operations planning. Understanding the source and magnitude of primary delays is also important for simulation. © 2024 The Authors.

titulo: Marine energy technologies
resumo: The global necessity for renewable energy is escalating day by day. The world is transferring toward affordable, clean, and carbon-neutral energy sources. Conventional forms of energy such as coal, oil, and gas have proven detrimental to the environment, creating a need for change to more sustainable forms of energy. Ocean energy technologies like wave energy, tidal stream, ocean thermal energy technology, osmotic power, and offshore wind have colossal capacity, among other renewable energy resources. Marine renewable energy is an emerging sector due to its predictability and commitment to sustainability. In 2023, the proportion of renewable energy in total annual capacity increased to 85.5%, with marine energy alone having a generation potential of 337GW. This chapter studies and assesses several types of marine technologies based on their design, accessibility, operation, and maintenance. As explored in this chapter, no previous studies have conducted a comprehensive investigation covering all relevant aspects such as sustainability, affordability, and performance of ocean energy technology. Future advancements aim to improve the efficiency and lifecycle of marine equipment and their protection under harsh marine conditions. Developing hybrid solutions and installing energy storage spaces will guarantee a more stable and consistent power source, addressing challenges to promote sustainable energy solutions. © 2026 Elsevier Inc. titulo: Probabilistic Health Monitoring and Maintenance Scheduling for Nuclear Power Systems
fonte_periodico: AIAA Science and Technology Forum and Exposition AIAA Scitech Forum 2025
resumo: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) cost optimization in the nuclear energy industry is an imperative task for developing sustainable systems and efficient renewable technologies. We present a modular probabilistic framework for addressing maintenance scheduling challenges for small modular nuclear reactors using a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) approach that monitors fatigue and performance in multiple subsystems of the reactors and provides a probabilistic assessment for potential failure events. The DBN framework fuses information from potential digital twins that assimilate real time data from several sensors with different time granularities in order to monitor and update thecurrentstate of knowledge aboutthestatus of several fatigue or performance criteria. Comprised of multi-modal digital twins (empirical, data- and physics-based twins), this DBN serves as a predictive framework forecasting the future state of specific reactor subsystems and enhancing decision-making capabilities associated with preventing system failure and minimizing the time and cost of maintenance events. The work presented in this paper is a holistic approach for monitoring and safeguarding complex, multi-component engineering systems where maintenance scheduling is critical and does not restrict itself to nuclear environments. However, our goal is to illustrate how such a framework can be adjusted to small modular water reactors. © 2025, American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics Inc, AIAA. All rights reserved.

titulo: Development of 3-D Surface Cost Response Maps for Predicting Rapid Costs of Biological Wastewater Treatment Using Moving Bed Biofilm Reactors
resumo: Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor (MBBR) is employed for economical municipal and industrial effluent treatment. However selection of the treatment technology should have a techno-commercial rationale so that the effective cost for sustainable implementation encapsulates economic and fiscal aspects. This paper presents the study made to work out the profile of variation of cost of WWTP with MBBR for different input BOD at varied flow rates and development of 3-D surface cost response maps based on generated data sets to provide instant information on cost of WWTP with MBBR. These 3-D maps are extracted from software by use of the data obtained as output from a model developed for system design, determination of bill of quantities and cost. No literature cost data has been used in this context. These 3-D maps developed for WWTPs with MBBR technology may be used to forecast costs for construction, operation and maintenance for twenty five years. This will provide stakeholders reliable and rapid cost information for WWTP with MBBR technology and enable them for comparison with other alternatives for a prudent selection of technology, particularly for decision makers. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Singapore Pte Ltd. 2025.

titulo: A Quantitative Approach to Modeling the Overconsumption of Energy in Healthcare Buildings
resumo: Healthcare buildings consume 2.6 times more energy than commercial buildings, primarily due to the operation of electromedical equipment and the stringent indoor environmental requirements for medical practice. This fact underscores the need for research aimed at addressing the high intensity of energy consumption. For this purpose, methods employing building energy simulation, mathematical correlation models, and machine learning algorithms have been developed to quantify the impact of various variables on energy consumption. However, the specific influence of individual attribute variations within these variables has not yet been fully disaggregated. To bridge this gap in knowledge, 70 healthcare buildings in Spain were analyzed to model the interaction among parameters in healthcare buildings affecting the overconsumption of energy. The quantitative multifactor dimensionality reduction method was employed to analyze the phenomenon under study by developing three models: final energy consumption, energy demand, and thermal energy consumption. Having more than 5000 assigned patients increases the likelihood of exceeding final energy consumption by 17.3%, relying on fossil fuel boilers for heating raises the risk of higher-than-average energy demand by 30.0%, and installing heat pumps with less than 5 kW power increases the risk of elevated thermal energy consumption by 15.0%–38.1%. Results indicate that energy consumption intensity is significantly influenced by demographic variables and the heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems of healthcare buildings. The research findings will guide the design of new healthcare buildings and assist facility managers in more effectively allocating operational expenses. titulo: Performance assessment of a Lithium-ion battery in an Electric vehicle by using machine learning and deep learning approach
fonte_periodico: 5th IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Energy and Future Electric Transportation Sefet 2025
resumo: As the global adoption of electric vehicles (EVS) rises due to their environmental benefits, the performance and lifespan of lithium-ion batteries become critical factors in vehicle cost-efficiency. Recent advancements in modelling and machine learning (ML) techniques have improved our ability to analyse battery data and predict parameters under varying conditions. This study explores the application of ML and deep learning (DL) methods to predict future values of battery parameters using a publicly available dataset of Panasonic 18650 batteries. Three distinct models based on ML and DL - one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1d CNN), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bilstm), and Auto Regression (AR) were compared to assess their effectiveness. Results demonstrated that the 1d CNN model significantly outperformed both Bilstm and AR models in accuracy and performance, as measured by mean absolute error and mean squared error metrics. This research underscores the value of ML and DL techniques in accurately estimating battery parameters, which facilitates optimised design, operation, and maintenance of Li-ion batteries. By enhancing our understanding of battery behavior, this study supports advancing renewable energy sources and electric vehicles, paving the way for a more sustainable energy future.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Economic insights for residential heating and domestic hot water energy services: a comparative analysis with a focus on solar systems integration
resumo: Countries are responding to the need to reduce their carbon footprints by adopting new sustainable energy technologies through emerging trends and economic models. One of these trends is the”Energy-as-a-Service” (EaaS) model, where companies assume responsibility for investment, operation, and maintenance, while consumers benefit from sustainable energy services. This study aims to analyze the economic feasibility of integrating solar systems with conventional heating and domestic hot water (DHW) technologies in residential energy services, using a case study in France. Four technology configurations with two renewable energy inclusion scenarios are evaluated within an annual fee structure that covers the leasing and maintenance of the heating and DHW devices. The analysis applies financial methods such as the total annualized cost (TAC) and the benefit-cost ratio (BCR), with the provider supplying both electricity and heat. The study offers preliminary insights into how economic parameters, such as energy tariffs and financial incentives, influence the transition to energy services. The results indicate that the annual service fee varies significantly depending on factors like capital costs, equipment lifespan, discount rate, and energy prices. Furthermore, integration of photovoltaic systems (PV) suggests that the valuation of the business model can differ depending on the compensation scheme for exported generation, highlighting the need for a global sensitivity analysis to draw more conclusive insights. © 2025 Institute of Physics Publishing. All rights reserved.

titulo: Application of Genetic Algorithm-Optimized Backpropagation Network in Library Energy Consumption Prediction
resumo: The development of building energy consumption prediction models is crucial for achieving sustainable development in the construction industry; however, establishing rational, accurate, and efficient models to promote energy conservation and enhance energy utilization efficiency remains a challenge. This study takes libraries as a representative building type, selecting operational hours, humidity, maximum temperature, occupancy density, and solar irradiance as key influencing factors to construct a Genetic Algorithm-optimized Backpropagation (GA-BP) neural network for energy consumption prediction. Comparative experiments with a standard Backpropagation (BP) neural network, Regularized Radial Basis Function (RRBF) neural network, and Generalized Radial Basis Function (GRBF) neural network demonstrate the superior fitting performance of the GA-BP model, providing reliable scientific support for library energy management and offering a practical framework for energy-efficient building operations. © 2025 X. Tian & H. Xie.

titulo: Space Supercomputing: Conception,Challenge and Application
resumo: Space supercomputing refers to supercomputing systems deployed in extraterrestrial space,capable of scientific computing,intelligent computing,and big data processing. With the advent of the post-Moore’s Law era,the rapid development of energy technology and aerospace technology,and the urgent need for human space migration,space supercomputing is poised to become a strtegic high ground in future technological development. As a new concept product,space supercomputing faces challenges in aspects such as system architecture technology,megawatt-level space power generation and energy storage technology,heat dissipation technology,communication technology,reliability technology,operation and maintenance technology,reusable launch vehicle technology,low-cost technology,and sustainable operation. Space supercomputing plays an important application value in supporting space numerical calculations and the operation of space bases,while driving the development of space-based power utilization,reusable launch vehicles,and space information technology. It is expected that an investment of the order of several billion yuan can be used to build a P-level space supercomputing verification system within five years；and industrialized operation will be formed in about 30 years. Humanity will enter the space information era from the era of satellites and space stations,and the development and utilization of space will reach a new level. © 2025, Chinese Society of Astronautics. titulo: LabTwinXR: A Real-Time eXtended Reality Digital Twin Testbed for Smart Buildings
fonte_periodico: Proceedings of the 11th IEEE International Smart Cities Conference Resilient and Sustainable Smart Communities Isc2 2025
resumo: Smart cities evolve toward more sustainable and resilient infrastructures, integrating real-time, user-centered technologies into building management is critical. LabTwinXR is a real-time eXtended Reality (XR) digital twin testbed deployed in a smart laboratory environment to support energy and indoor environmental quality (IEQ) management. The system combines Internet of Things (IoT) sensor data with immersive Virtual and Augmented Reality interfaces, enabling users to interact with realtime energy, temperature and CO2 metrics. By enabling bidirectional interaction, the system moves beyond the limitations of digital shadows and aligns with the definition of a true digital twin. Three use cases demonstrate the system's capability to enhance energy-aware building operations through immersive, human-in-the-loop control. Preliminary evaluation results demonstrate low-latency and positive user experience ratings (UEQ-S). These findings confirm the system's viability for immersive, energy-aware building management.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Research on Operational State Prediction and Optimization Methods for New Energy Equipment Based on Digital Twins
fonte_periodico: Proceedings 2025 4th International Conference on Clean Energy Storage and Power Engineering Cespe 2025
resumo: To address the complex operational characteristics, fluctuating efficiency, and insufficient predictive capability of new energy equipment, this study proposes a digital twin-based operational state prediction and optimization framework. The approach establishes a high-fidelity virtual-physical mapping system integrating real-Time sensor data, process models, and historical operational records. A hybrid prediction model combining Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) and gated recurrent units (GRU) is constructed to capture nonlinear temporal dependencies and improve fault trend prediction accuracy. The optimization layer introduces a multi-objective strategy based on Pareto dominance, balancing energy consumption, system stability, and prediction precision. The system architecture encompasses data acquisition, model training, and optimization control, achieving closed-loop synchronization between the physical and virtual environments. Experimental validation on a wind-solar hybrid energy platform demonstrates that the proposed model improves prediction accuracy by 9.4%, enhances energy optimization efficiency by 12.7%, and reduces latency by 31% compared with conventional methods. The results confirm that digital twin-driven state prediction provides effective support for intelligent operation and maintenance, enabling adaptive scheduling and real-Time fault prevention in new energy systems. This research offers practical guidance for constructing intelligent, efficient, and sustainable energy management frameworks in future industrial application.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Innovation management strategies for industrial machinery maintenance: Enhancing competitive advantage
resumo: In a rapidly evolving technological and business environment, business leaders must adapt quickly to maintain their competitiveness. The main objective of this article is to propose a maintenance management guide with the innovation management process to help organizations develop effective innovation strategies and respond to the challenges of the Industry 4.0 era. It examines the principles and strategies of innovation management in the maintenance of industrial machinery and their impact on competitiveness. It focuses on the integration of digital technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and big data analytics into maintenance processes. This article explains that the introduction of modern technologies in the areas of predictive maintenance, condition-based maintenance, and intelligent maintenance significantly reduces machine downtime, increases production efficiency, and lowers operating costs. However, implementing these innovations comes with challenges, including data management, cybersecurity risks, lack of employee skills, and high investment costs, especially for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). This article proposes a structured transition plan for the introduction of innovative maintenance strategies. The approach focuses on upskilling the workforce and cultivating an innovation-oriented corporate culture. By addressing these challenges, companies can strengthen their competitiveness and long-term sustainability in an increasingly digitalized industrial landscape. © 2025 by the authors; licensee Learning Gate.

titulo: Optimization of mining equipment maintenance scheduling based on multiobjective genetic algorithm
fonte_periodico: Proceedings of SPIE the International Society for Optical Engineering
resumo: Aiming at the optimization problem of piston reciprocating pump maintenance scheduling, this paper proposes an optimization method based on multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA), which aims to minimize the total maintenance cost, minimize downtime and maximize system reliability at the same time. By constructing a multi-objective mathematical model and combining the fitness evaluation mechanism of non-dominated sorting and crowding distance, the algorithm can efficiently generate the Pareto optimal solution set. Simulation experiments verify that MOGA is superior to the single-objective genetic algorithm (SGA) and the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm (MOPSO) in terms of coverage and hypervolume indicators. Its uniformly distributed solution set and fast convergence characteristics demonstrate its applicability in complex multi-objective optimization scenarios. Visual analysis further reveals the trade-off relationship between objectives and provides diversified solutions for maintenance scheduling decisions. This study provides theoretical support and practical reference for the intelligent and efficient maintenance management of mining equipment, and has significant engineering application value. © 2025 SPIE.

titulo: Resilience and sustainability toward asset management improvement
fonte_periodico: Digital Transformation in the Construction Industry Sustainability Resilience and Data Centric Engineering
resumo: Maintenance and asset management (AM) are very important for the architecture, engineering, construction, and operation (AECO) sector. The increase in associated information makes it necessary to have greater control of it with the emergence of construction information classification systems (CICS), which are fundamental in the classification of information and its use. The built environment is vulnerable to risks that are impossible to eliminate, and this prompts the need for managing and classifying the resilience and sustainability of different constructed assets. This article contributes to a discussion on the ways to measure the resilience and sustainability of built assets, namely based on rating systems composed of different dimensions, several indicators, and parameters. It covers not only the building's intrinsic qualities but also its interdependence with the community, surroundings, and users in the context. This was achieved through the calibration of two resilience classification systems for different building typologies—research buildings in Lisbon, railway stations across Portugal, and public schools across Portugal, which marks a significant advancement in improving built environment resilience and sustainability. © 2025 Elsevier Ltd. titulo: Digital Twin for Maintenance and Disaster Management of the Cable-stayed Bridge
fonte_periodico: IABSE Symposium Tokyo 2025 Environmentally Friendly Technologies and Structures Focusing on Sustainable Approaches Report
resumo: Digitalization and adoption of a digital twin in the transport sector are considered to be a little bit slower than in other industries. However, as the use of BIM (Building Information Modeling) in infrastructure projects has rapidly increased, the concept of digital twin is beginning to be accepted for infrastructure management. To enhance maintenance and disaster management in the road sector through digital transformation, a pilot project was launched in 2023 to construct a digital twin of the Seohae Bridge, a cable-supported bridge. The Bridge consists of a cable-stayed bridge and two different types of pre-stressed concrete box girder bridges. The digital twin for the Seohae Bridge is constructed by integrating the following components: a BIM-based 3D digital model, UAV-based defect inspection data and real-time sensor data, scenario-based structural events simulation analysis, real-time bridge safety assessment, and AI algorithm-based sensor data monitoring. © 2025 IABSE Symposium Tokyo 2025: Environmentally Friendly Technologies and Structures: Focusing on Sustainable Approaches - Report All rights reserved.

titulo: Environmental-economic assessment of hybrid power systems for fishing vessels
fonte_periodico: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part M Journal of Engineering for the Maritime Environment
resumo: Decarbonization of the fishing sector is an important step toward achieving global climate goals while ensuring the long-term sustainability of marine ecosystems. This sector, heavily reliant on fossil fuels, particularly for vessel operations, contributes significantly to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Hybrid and multi-source energy systems, including microgrids that integrate renewables and energy storage, offer a sustainable solution for optimizing energy use, enhancing efficiency, and stabilizing power. This paper involves microgrid configurations for trawlers and purse seiners, two types of fishing vessels with distinct operating profiles. Through load scheduling based on fuel consumption measurement results, the study provides a cost-benefit analysis that reflects each vessel’s unique energy requirements, offering insights into optimal power solutions for the fishing industry. Three distinct configurations have been analyzed: diesel engine-powered, hybrid (diesel generator with battery storage), and plug-in hybrid. The simulations offer financial variables such as Net Present Cost (NPC) and Operation and Maintenance (O&M) costs to determine the most cost-effective solution. Results show that for purse seiners, diesel engine-powered configurations incurred the highest NPC, primarily due to high diesel fuel costs. Plug-in and model demonstrated lower NPCs, benefiting from greater energy efficiency despite higher initial investments. For trawlers, the plug-in model achieved the lowest NPC, while the hybrid configuration yielded costs higher than diesel engine. Across both vessel types, fuel remained the dominant cost driver, highlighting the critical importance of energy-efficient operation. © IMechE 2025

titulo: Contextual Decision-Making Framework for Green Hydrogen Projects: Insights from Colombia Via FAHP
resumo: This study presents a structured methodology based on the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) to identify and rank the most relevant criteria for the planning and execution of green hydrogen projects in Colombia. Drawing from a comprehensive literature review and the input of 129 experts from academic, industrial, governmental, and research sectors, five primary criteria-economic, environmental, technical, social, and risk - and 40 sub-criteria were assessed using surveys and fuzzy pairwise comparison matrices. The results show that the economic criterion is the most influential, with a normalized weight of 42.84 %, followed by environmental (28.06 %) and social (10.91 %) criteria. At the sub-criteria level, the most critical factors were operation and maintenance costs, return on investment, and the use of renewable energy sources to power electrolyzers. These findings reflect the prevailing priorities of stakeholders within Colombia's energy sector. The novelty of this study lies in its contextualized application of FAHP, which integrates expert judgment and fuzzy logic in emerging regions characterized by high uncertainty. Key contributions include the development of a replicable hierarchical model, empirical validation of decisive factors, and a decision-support tool to guide strategic planning. The model is recommended for informing public policies and investment strategies aimed at advancing green hydrogen deployment. Its adaptability further supports application in other Latin American countries with similar regulatory and infrastructural contexts.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: A novel smart grid concept for a 100% green hybrid energy system
resumo: As global efforts to combat climate change and reduce greenhouse gas emissions intensify, renewable energy systems have become a cornerstone of modern energy strategies and environmental policies. This study investigates the potential and challenges of implementing fully green hybrid energy systems, with a particular focus on energy storage as a critical component. Two configurations are analyzed to enhance system performance, reliability, and cost efficiency in a 100% renewable energy microgrid: (1) a photovoltaic (PV) and battery storage system (BSS) and (2) a PV/wind turbine (WT)/BSS system. The research targets the optimization of a hybrid energy system for an industrial community in New Minya, Egypt, utilizing site-specific solar radiation and wind speed data for precise design and simulation. Key economic metrics, including net present cost (NPC), levelized cost of energy (LCOE), and installation, operation, and maintenance costs, are evaluated for each configuration. Simulations and optimizations are conducted using HOMER software, developed by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory. Results indicate that the PV/BSS configuration is both economically viable and environmentally sustainable, with an NPC of $88,429, an LCOE of $0.116 per kWh, and zero carbon emissions. This configuration emerges as a competitive alternative to diesel generator systems, offering significant economic and environmental benefits. Additionally, the PV/WT/BSS system achieved an LCOE of $0.119 per kWh, demonstrating cost-effectiveness while maintaining zero emissions. Both configurations outperform traditional diesel-based systems, which are characterized by higher operational costs and considerable environmental drawbacks. © The Institution of Engineering and Technology and its licensors 2025.

titulo: Enhancing Design Efficiency and Interconnecting 3D Data Models Through BIM Library Implementation: A Case Study from the Trans Sumatera Toll Road Project
resumo: The Lematang–Panjang Port Toll Road Project, which is part of the Trans Sumatra Toll Road network managed by PT Hutama Karya, spans 11 km, using Building Information Modeling (BIM) in its planning stage. The main challenge of this project is the very short work timeline with a large number of buildings. To overcome these obstacles, automation of work processes is important to reduce repetitive work. This study focuses on increasing efficiency by comparing the manual process using the in-place model with the automated process using BIM library objects, which simplify model creation and enable automatic updates through parameter adjustments, resulting in accelerated 3D model production with a time efficiency increase of 64.9%. In addition, considering that 1853 km of the Trans Sumatra Toll Road still needs to be built, this BIM library will not only streamline the design process and ensure conflict-free output, but will also function as a Big Database to connect all data for the Toll Road Project in Sumatra and support the design process in subsequent projects, improve consistency and efficiency across the network, and support sustainability from the beginning of the project to the operation and maintenance phase. © The Author(s), under exclusive license to Springer Nature Singapore Pte Ltd. 2025.

titulo: Toward a Metamodelling Approach for Water Distribution Systems
fonte_periodico: Ichms 2025 5th IEEE International Conference on Human Machine Systems AI and Large Language Models Transforming Human Machine Interactions
resumo: Water Distribution Systems (WDSs) are critical infrastructures that ensure the reliable supply of water to urban and industrial areas. Modern WDSs have evolved into complex cyberphysical systems and smart environments, integrating advanced sensing, control, and data analytics technologies to enhance efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. The design and management of these systems are inherently complex due to the interplay of hydraulic, environmental, and operational factors. Given the scale and complexity of WDSs, adopting robust modeling approaches is essential to optimize their design, operation, and maintenance. Despite the recognized need for systematic methodologies, existing approaches often lack a structured framework for modeling WDSs at a high level of abstraction. This paper proposes a metamodeling approach to WDSs by leveraging the Smart Environment Metamodel (SEM) framework. SEM offers a structured methodology for representing complex systems, enabling a more systematic and adaptable approach to WDS modeling. SEM can play a pivotal role in the design of critical systems like WDSs, as it allows designers to embed mechanisms for protection and resilience, ensuring that vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated throughout the development process. This study explores the application of SEM in the WDSs domain, highlighting its potential benefits. In addition, it discusses how SEM can be further enhanced to better address specific challenges of WDSs, paving the way for more advanced, intelligent, and adaptive water distribution infrastructures. © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Dynamic resilience assessment and multi-objective optimization decision-making for urban roadway tunnel system in the face of fire disaster
autores: Sun, HL; Lan, HJ; He, ZL; Pan, XD; Zhang, RR; Zhang, PF; Tong, JH
resumo: The urban roadway tunnel system (URTS), as an infrastructure system that includes equipment and facilities, operational staff, and traffic participants, faces challenges arising from various potential fire threats. Existing studies on tunnel fire risk primarily focus on static assessment, neglecting dynamic changes over time, and insufficiently considering the complexity of tunnel composition, leading to incomplete identification of influential factors. Additionally, few studies were conducted to develop optimal operation and maintenance (O&M) strategies under cost constraints. To bolster fire safety management of URTS, a fire framework that combines resilience assessment and optimization is proposed based on system resilience theory, Bayesian network (BN), and multi-objective optimization (MOPT) in this paper. The framework is applied to Hangzhou's URTS. The results indicate that Hangzhou's URTS has a current “Medium” fire resilience level of 0.640, decreasing to 0.568 in 20 years without scientific O&M. The static and dynamic strategies are acquired through sensitivity and critical importance analysis, enhancing long-term fire resilience. Moreover, optimal strategies for varied investments in diverse periods are explored, considering O&M costs and resilience levels. The fire resilience framework introduced herein can integrate into various infrastructure systems, effectively enhancing disaster resilience and promoting sustainable development. © 2024 Elsevier Ltd

titulo: Research on Fault Diagnosis Technology of Low-Voltage Distributed Photovoltaic Grid Connection Based on Machine Learning
fonte_periodico: Proceedings 2025 International Conference on Electrical Drives Power Electronics and Engineering Edpee 2025
resumo: With the wide application of distributed photovoltaic power generation system, its stability and reliability have become the key factors in the energy supply system. In this paper, the fault diagnosis technology of low-voltage distributed photovoltaic grid connection based on machine learning (ML) is studied, aiming at improving the operation and maintenance efficiency and fault handling ability of photovoltaic system. Firstly, the collected data are preprocessed, including data cleaning, denoising, normalization and feature extraction to ensure the accuracy and availability of the data. Through statistical analysis, signal processing and wavelet transform, the key indicators reflecting the fault characteristics of photovoltaic system, such as voltage volatility and current harmonic content, are extracted. Then, this paper constructs a convolutional neural network (CNN) model based on deep learning (DL) for fault diagnosis. The model is optimized by back propagation algorithm and gradient descent method, and the hyperparameter is optimized by cross validation and grid search to improve the generalization ability of the model. The experimental results show that the CNN model achieves 95% accuracy and 0.94 F1 score on the independent test set, which shows a high ability to identify all kinds of faults. This study not only provides technical support for the stable operation of photovoltaic system, but also contributes a new perspective to the sustainable development of energy and technological innovation.  © 2025 IEEE.

titulo: Sanitary Sewer Construction Methodology
resumo: The choice among three construction methods for sanitary sewer, open-cut construction (for gravity sewers), pilot tube micro-tunneling (for gravity sewers), and lift station with force main (using horizontal directional drilling method for the installation of the underground sewer pipeline), was evaluated through the lens of sustainable construction. Four major aspects of sustainable construction (social, economic, environmental, and technical) were considered to arrive at the most suitable option for this construction. The social aspect considered public safety and odor as relating to how social life in the community will be affected. The economic aspect considered both the construction cost and the operations and maintenance cost. The environmental evaluation considered greenhouse gas production and noise pollution. The technical aspect considered constructability and the use of specialized equipment. Expert interviews were conducted to evaluate the opinion of diverse stakeholders on the project, including Developers, City Engineers, and the Public. Multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) criteria (Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution, TOPSIS) was used to evaluate the responses received. Analysis of the results showed a difference in preference for the construction method. While Developers and the Public preferred the open-trench construction, City Engineers preferred the pilot tube alternative. Overall, from the present analysis, open-trench construction was the preferred choice for construction. The authors would like to note that the decision to choose a specific method of construction for underground sewer lines is site-specific. © Canadian Society for Civil Engineering 2025.
